summary.en: Keystone Myth Requires 3,600 Mythic+ Score in Patch 12.1.5...
summary.es: Keystone Myth requiere 3.600 Mítica+ Score en el parche 12.1.5...

contentHtml:
The Keystone Myth achievement is returning in Patch 12.1.5 and will require 3,600 Mythic+ score!

Midnight Season 2 Mythic+ Overview


Keystone Myth was a brand new achievement added in Midnight Season 1 to incentivize players to push higher keystones in Mythic+. While Midnight Keystone Myth: Season 1 required 3,400 score, Season 2 now requires 3,600 score. This means that players will need more than half the dungeons on an +18, on average, compared to the flat +16s of last season.

Blizzard also mentions that dungeon tuning is coming to address problem points in the current dungeon pool.

While the rewards haven't been explicitly mentioned, the reward will likely be the same as Season 1 of a Timelost Saddle. This allows you to choose a mount from a list.
Blizzard
View Original

Demonstrate Your Mastery with Season 2’s Keystone Myth

Test your Mythic+ skills when Keystone Myth returns in the Midnight 12.1.5 content update. In Season 2, the Unbinding of Kith’ix raid and Labyrinth of Kindo’jan offer new ways to strengthen your character, take on higher Keystones, and earn the "Midnight Keystone Myth: Season 2" achievement by reaching a Mythic+ rating of 3600.

The goal with Keystone Myth is to offer a meaningful challenge during the second half of each season, with a rating requirement that reflects dungeon difficulty and gear progression. For Season 2, we’ve considered both current rating data and the rewards still to come. When Keystone Myth returns in 12.1.5, we’ll also make targeted dungeon tuning adjustments to address difficulty outliers.

title.es: Midnight Patch 12.1.5 se estrena el 13 de octubre

summary.es: Midnight Patch 12.1.5 se estrena el 13 de octubre...

contentHtml:
Blizzard has announced that Midnight Patch 12.1.5 will be released on October 13th for NA and October 14th for EU!
Blizzard
View Original
The next Midnight content update tests your mettle with new trials, more power, and greater rewards.
When : October 13th / 14 October (with weekly maintenance)
Gather your allies for a single-boss raid against Kith’ix, with flexible Mythic difficulty. Venture into the Labyrinth of Kindo’jan, a massive, Delve-like gauntlet with nine chambers, a Tier 11 solo challenge, Mythic gear, cosmetics, titles, and more. Push your power to new heights in Season 2 with the mid-season refresh and Keystone Mythic. Begin a new story campaign that returns you to the heart of Quel’Thalas and Zul’Aman for the continuation of the Midnight saga.

Explore What’s Ahead

  • Season 2 Mid-Season Refresh: Get Started with Orin in Silvermoon City
  • New Single-Boss Raid: The Unbinding of Kith’ix
  • Labyrinth of Kindo’jan
  • Season 2 Keystone Myth
  • New Story Campaign: The Promise of Tomorrow
  • Outdoor Event: Aqir Invasion

Mid-Season Refresh: Unlock New Power


During realm maintenance the week of 7 October , Orin Straylight will begin to offer one additional Nebulous Voidcore a week to bonus roll for additional loot.

Prepare to unlock these additional Nebulous Voidcores before Midnight’s 12.1.5 content update goes live. First, accept the "In the Catalyst's Shadow" quest from Decimus in Voidstorm, then travel to Silvermoon City and pick up the “Prismatic Potential” quest from Orin Straylight. To get an early start on the Nebulous Voidcore quest chain, we encourage Azeroth’s brave champions to complete both quests before weekly maintenance during the week of October 6.

Once “Prismatic Potential” is turned in, Orin can begin his research, and a progress timer will appear above his head. After completing his research during the week of October 6, he will offer the quest "Umbral Blessings of the Catalyst". Completing this quest will unlock the ability to trade in gold, Voidlight Marl, or Veteran Mistcrests to Orin for one additional Nebulous Voidcore a week.

During realm maintenance the week of October 13, Orin will offer the quest, "Ancient Depths, Ancient Venom". Once this quest is complete, Orin will begin his next research of Ascendant Venomstones. Orin will complete his research during realm maintenance the week of October 20 and offer players "Ascending with Venomstones", letting players take their power to new heights. Completing this quest will empower defenders of the realm to acquire Ascendant Venomstones, which drop from every Heroic or Mythic raid boss, Mythic+ Keystone dungeons at +10 and above, Tier 11 Bountiful Delves, and Nightmare Prey Hunt Champion gear chests.

After collecting 10 Ascendant Venomstones, use them near the Catalyst in Silvermoon City to raise the item level of a fully upgraded Season 2 Hero, Myth, or maximum-quality Tidal Crafted weapon, trinket, or necklace.

Along with Ascendant Venomstones, the week of 21 October, the crest cap will be lifted.

New Single-Boss Raid: The Unbinding of Kith’ix


Hidden beneath the Venomous Abyss, Kith’ix was bound in his subterranean lair. With Ula’tek’s defeat, the restraints keeping Kith’ix at bay have weakened, unleashing the monstrosity the Amani locked away so long ago.

Confront Kith’ix with Lady Liadrin at your side in a focused single-boss raid that brings the campaign’s escalating threat to a decisive confrontation, with Story Mode, Normal, Heroic, and Mythic difficulties. On Mythic difficulty, face Kith’ix with a flexible group of 15–25 players.

Gather your allies and prepare for a battle that brings the story of Quel’Thalas and Zul’Aman to a close.

Labyrinth of Kindo’jan: Conquer the Depths to Claim the Rewards


This ancient Amani funeral complex has been sealed for centuries. Now reopened, looters and Vilebranch comb the complex for relics while the interred spirits defend it with deadly force.

Love Delves but want a massive adventure with greater reward? Then the Labyrinth of Kindo’jan is for you.

While keeping the spirit of exploration, discovery, and overcoming challenges alongside a companion, a Labyrinth is a sprawling, mega-dungeon-like experience designed to be conquered on your terms, with dedicated progression systems, powerful unlocks, and rewards that match the scale of the challenge, including Mythic gear.

Like Delves, the Labyrinth of Kindo’jan will send you into danger with a trusted companion, Valeera Sanguinar, to guide you deeper into the unknown.

Venture through a Labyrinth in a single epic session or tackle it one wing at a time. You can explore a single wing and still earn rewards, but each additional room completed brings more opportunities to claim treasure—and more risks to overcome.

Demonstrate Your Mastery with Season 2’s Keystone Myth

Test your Mythic+ skills when Keystone Myth returns in the Midnight 12.1.5 content update. In Season 2, the Unbinding of Kith’ix raid and Labyrinth of Kindo’jan offer new ways to strengthen your character, take on higher Keystones, and earn the "Midnight Keystone Myth: Season 2" achievement by reaching a Mythic+ rating of 3600.
The goal with Keystone Myth is to offer a meaningful challenge during the second half of each season, with a rating requirement that reflects dungeon difficulty and gear progression. For Season 2, we’ve considered both current rating data and the rewards still to come. When Keystone Myth returns in 12.1.5, we’ll also make targeted dungeon tuning adjustments to address difficulty outliers.

Story Campaign: “The Promise of Tomorrow”


Ula'tek's defeat has awoken a long-slumbering terror. Temper an uneasy peace between Quel'Thalas and Zul ‘Aman, descend to the deepest depths of the Coiled Isle, and make a final stand against the Amani's ancient foe—the C'Thraxxi general, Kith'ix.

Outdoor Event: Aqir Invasion


Charge into Aqir Invasions—new zone-wide public events taking place in Eversong or Zul’Aman. For ten minutes each hour, champions will tackle a series of public events across the zone, one after another, before confronting an intense boss fight.

Whether you’re fending off aerial assaults or rallying defenders on the ground, the Aqir forces won’t stand a chance against the champions of Azeroth.

Each invasion features six scenario types: three combat-focused and three non-combat-focused. Combat scenarios can have one of eight possible affixes. Champions who band together will be rewarded for completing as many objectives as possible before the ten-minute window closes.

Affixes

  • Void Protection: Chance for an Aqir Voidweaver to appear, creating a protective barrier around all other Aqir.
  • Aqir Burrower: Several Aqir aggressively burrow through the area. They will knock anyone into the sky if they get close.
  • Void Sphere: Void Spheres move around the area to try to trap anyone within them.
  • Astalor's Anguish: Astalor's experiments continue. He has sent his Anguish Crystals to help, which will cause damage to the aqir and any adventurers caught in their blast.
  • Swarms!: All aqir enemies are replaced with swarms of smaller aqir.
  • Aqir Elites: All aqir enemies are replaced with fewer but more powerful aqir.
  • Void Infestation: Some aqir are infested with the void and will explode after a few seconds in combat, dealing damage to players and infecting other aqir.
  • Web Weavers: Chance for an Aqir Webweaver to spawn in. If their channel is not interrupted, they will cover a player in webs.
Gather your allies and step into the next chapter of Midnight on 14 October.

title.en: What to Do in Dalaran in WoW: Forever
title.es: Qué hacer en Dalaran en WoW: Forever

summary.en: What to Do in Dalaran in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Qué hacer en Dalaran en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
During the reveal of World of Warcraft: Forever, one of the trailer's key scenes showed Dalaran's protective dome dissipating, and now Dalaran City is a playable zone that players can access during the Beta. While this zone is marked as a Sanctuary, the Horde are not welcome inside the city walls. If you want to walk the city's grounds unharmed, you'll need to be Alliance. Now that Dalaran City is available, what all can players do there?

Forever Zones Overview - New & Updated Zones

Accessing Dalaran City

Dalaran City is located in the Alterac Mountains, just Northwest of Southshore. You can enter the city in three ways. First, you can enter up the staircase just north of Hillsbrad Fields. Second, a flying "boat" travels from Dalaran to Valanaar in Zephras Isle, the main hub for the new Skyborne race, and lands right outside the Violet Citadel, just south of Fenris Isle. Finally, there's a portal inside the Violet Citadel to Stormwind City. This takes you to the Wizard's Sanctum in the city, and there's a portal there back to Dalaran City. Currently, no flight paths land in Dalaran.

Available Quests

As of now, at Level 20 in the WoW Forever Beta, only one quest is available: A Donation of Wool from Belanaa Windveil inside The Sky Enclave in the Violet Citadel. This is a typical cloth donation chain that begins by donating 60 Wool Cloth, followed by 60 Silk Cloth, 60 Mageweave Cloth, and 60 Runecloth.

Class Trainers

Throughout Dalaran, two class trainers are available: Druid and Mage. You can find the Druid trainer inside The Violet Citadel, just outside the landing zone for the flying "boat." The NPC is named Alfina Nightgaze. As for the Mage trainer, you can find Jessa Weaver just inside The Violet Gate at /way 17.7 69.7.

Profession Trainers

In all, seven profession trainers have been found, with a hint of an eighth. Weirdly enough, none of the Kirin'Tor Guard NPCs in the city offer directions like those in other cities.
  • First Aid: Angelique Butler /way 17.4 61.2.
  • Enchanting: Vanessa Sellers /way 16.9 62.6.
  • Cooking: Katherine Lee, inside the Silver Enclave, located at /way 12.7 64.2.
  • Herbalism: Edward Egan /way 18.4 63.4.
  • Blacksmithing: Alard Schmied inside Violet Plates and Framing /way 19.6 63.3.
  • Tailoring: Charles Worth inside Talismanic Textiles at /way 17.8 60.4. Spellweaver Thaldris, a Transmogrifier, is also inside this building.
  • Alchemy: Linzy Blackbolt inside The Agronomical Apothecary /way 18.6 62.4.
As for the possible profession trainer, we found an NPC, Timothy Jones, at /way 18.1 61.9. This was inside the store "Cartier & Co. Fine Jewelry. He's listed as an Apprentice Jeweler, which is a title that usually signals a trainer. It's not confirmed, of course, but Jewelcrafting could be in WoW Forever's future.

Stable Master

You can find a Stable Master in Dalaran. The NPC is Talia Softglen, located inside the Magical Menagerie, at /way 19.7 70.1.

Barbershop

For players who want to change their appearance, head to Eclipse with Shears to sit in the barber chair and update their look at /way 20.1 66.6.

Battlemasters

Inside The Underbelly, players can queue for all battlegrounds, including Warsong Gulch, Arathi Basin, Alterac Valley, and Darkspear Islands, with the following NPCs:
  • Bimble Sparkfingers: Darkspear Islands
  • "Techs" Rickard Rustbolt: Warsong Gulch
  • Minzi the Minx: Arathi Basin
  • Sai: Alterac Valley


You can also buy PvP gear from "Dapper" Danik Blackshaft (Officer Accessories Quartermaster), Nixi Fireclaw (Weapons), and Blazik Fireclaw (Armor).

City of Dalaran Dungeon

Alliance players can access the pipe leading to the new City of Dalaran dungeon in the Cantrips & Crows area, down in the Dalaran Sewers. There, you'll find a gate to open, then continue down the pipe until you reach the instance portal.



Horde players can access this dungeon from outside Dalaran at /way 8.8 59.6. However, you'll need the Dalaran Sewer Key to access it.

title.en: Enjoy More Fun Transformations in WoW: Forever with the Savory Whimsyfin Delight
title.es: Disfruta de más transformaciones divertidas en WoW: para siempre con Savory Whimsyfin Delight

summary.en: Enjoy More Fun Transformations in WoW: Forever with the Savory Whimsyfin Delight...
summary.es: Disfruta de más transformaciones divertidas en WoW: para siempre con el Savory Whimsyfin Delight...

contentHtml:
In Classic World of Warcraft, players know and love the consumable Savory Deviate Delight. Players can craft it with Cooking, and when used, it turns the player into either a ninja or a pirate. Now, in World of Warcraft: Forever, players can acquire a new version of this item: Savory Whimsyfin Delight!


Players can turn into a Murloc or Ogre based on their character's Body Type selection


Players can also make this new consumable with Cooking, and the recipe Recipe: Savory Whimsyfin Delight can drop from random mobs such as Great Goretusk in Redridge Mountains.

However, instead of turning you into a ninja or pirate, it turns you into something specific to your Body Type selection. For characters with Body Type 1, it'll turn you into a Murloc; for Body Type 2, it'll turn you into a massive Ogre. This is a fun addition because two of the most popular races players wanted to play heading into WoW Forever were Murlocs and Ogres (more so Ogres). Now, with Savory Whimsyfin Delight, players can live that out for 60 minutes (or until they die)!


Don't worry, the Ninja and Pirate options are still available too - you can't beat the classics.

title.en: WoW: Forever AH Currently Bugged - Too Much Deposit Being Taken
title.es: WoW: Forever AH actualmente con micrófonos ocultos - Se está tomando demasiado depósito

summary.en: WoW: Forever AH Currently Bugged - Too Much Deposit Being Taken...
summary.es: WoW: Forever AH actualmente con micrófonos - Se está tomando demasiado depósito...

contentHtml:
If you're finding yourself missing money, it may have been eaten by the Auction House in WoW: Forever - there's currently a bug where too much silver is being taken for deposit.

Many players have reported that they've been mysteriously missing more money than they thought they should have had, and while it's easy to write this off as mistaken math, it turns out the Auction House might be the culprit. When every silver counts at early levels to train new skills, having more taken than it appears can quickly mean players come up short-changed right when they need money the most.

Visit Reddit


As reported on Reddit, the Auction House seemingly was taking exactly 1 for many auctions, even when the value of the items should have triggered a significantly smaller deposit. After testing, it was confirmed that, yes, the AH was taking more than the display said in several cases.

For example, when posting a Lesser Healing Potion, the sell price was 89, and the listed deposit was 4. Before the transaction was posted, the amount of silver and copper left was 34 61. After posting the Lesser Healing Potion, the available amount fell by exactly 1 to 33 61. This was tested with several different items, and for those with the lowest copper amounts required to place a deposit, it seemed that the minimum amount taken each time defaulted to 1.



If the deposit amount is more than 1, though, it seems like there are still rounding errors at the bare minimum. An example here was when posting a Blazing Wand, the total price was 22, and the deposit was listed at 1 32. After posting the wand, the remaining money went from 33 61 to 32 27. This was interesting because, yes, this was a more precise deposit fee, but considering the starting balance of 33 61 and the deposit fee of 1 32, the end balance should've been 32 29 - a difference of 2.

  


It seems that right now, on the Auction House in WoW Forever, all items being listed with a deposit amount of 1 or less will automatically round up to 1. However, for items that have a listed deposit of more than 1, it's much more precise (but it could still have some slight issues). If you're using the Auction House to try and generate extra money for training or consumables, it might be easier and safer to simply vendor the items for now, depending on the profit that could be made. Otherwise, players risk actually spending money to sell their items instead of earning it.

title.es: Blizzard confirma que Crit Nerf en PvP es un error en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Blizzard Confirms Crit Nerf in PvP is a Bug in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Blizzard confirma que Crit Nerf en PvP es un error en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
After the community raised concerns about potential critical strike damage changes in WoW: Forever PvP, Blizzard has confirmed that the nerf is a bug.

Many players who enjoy Classic PvP are extremely familiar with how things should feel, so it was very clear from the start when something was off. The community noticed that critical strikes didn't seem to do the proper amount of damage, and many Reddit threads pointed out the differences between Forever and Classic, including one that referenced a clip from Xaryu:

Visit Reddit


However, it seems that Blizzard is now confirming that this is an unintended bug, and players will be back to normal in a future build once the bug is fixed!

title.en: Blizzard Working on Putting Make-a-Wish Quest Back in WoW: Forever
title.es: Blizzard trabaja para volver a poner en marcha Make-a-Wish Quest en WoW: Forever

summary.en: Blizzard Working on Putting Make-a-Wish Quest Back in WoW: Forever...
summary.es: Blizzard está trabajando en volver a poner en marcha Make-a-Wish Quest en WoW: Forever...

contentHtml:
Ezra Chatterton created an iconic World of Warcraft quest as part of a Make-A-Wish request - and now, Blizzard is working on getting his questline implemented in WoW: Forever!

For those who don't know, in The Burning Crusade, Ezra Chatterton (also known as Ephoenix) was granted a wish through the Make-A-Wish program to design a World of Warcraft quest. That quest became Kyle's Gone Missing!, a small but impactful quest in Mulgore to help Ahab Wheathoof feed his dog, Kyle the Frenzied. Not only were Ezra's efforts immortalized in this quest, but his voice was too - Ezra recorded the voice lines for Ahab Wheathoof, leading to one of the most iconic quests Horde players experienced.

Because this quest was created in TBC, though, it was conspicuously missing from WoW: Forever - and players asked repeatedly across social media for Ezra's tribute to be added to this version of the game. Blizzard has taken notice, and it sounds like Kyle and his faithful Tauren will be added in to WoW: Forever!
Blizzard
View Original
Taharken said:
Link
I do hope they make the exception for the time frame and put him in.
We’re working on it.

Stay tuned!
An incredible tribute to an incredible child, Ahab and Kyle will once more be able to help fledgling Tauren on their journey to Thunder Bluff. There are dozens of other tributes scattered throughout Azeroth, and given that Forever is meant to be, well, forever, it would be wonderful to see other in-game tributes eventually added as well.
